uso: menu, Breath elegido: bienvenida mientras se avanza (21-10: "Welcome to <experiencia>", pedido de Beltran)
text: Welcome to Entering. For the next three minutes, you'll slow down and breathe with a guide. While you do, we'll gently listen to your body: your breath, your heart, and your mind.

uso: menu, Draw elegido: bienvenida mientras se avanza (21-10: "Welcome to <experiencia>", pedido de Beltran)
text: Welcome to Surrounding. For the next three minutes, you'll draw with light in the space around you. While you do, we'll gently listen to your heart and your mind.

uso: menu: el HUD termino de instalarse
text: Your signals are with you now. You're ready.

uso: Breath: aparece el metaball
text: This light moves with your breath. Breathe slowly, and watch it follow you.

uso: Breath: antes de la cuenta, explica la tecnica (21-10, arreglo 12: breathwork de referencia)
text: Now, a breath to calm your nervous system. Breathe in through your nose, filling your belly, then your chest. Hold for a moment. Then breathe out slowly through your mouth, as if through a straw. I'll guide each breath.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): cuenta antes del primer ciclo (la dice la demo con subtitulo; la etapa queda en silencio)
text: Three... two... one... inhale.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): inhalar, ciclo 2 (explica)
text: Breathe in through your nose... fill your belly, then your chest.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): inhalar, ciclos 3 en adelante
text: Breathe in.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): sostener (todas las retenciones salvo la de pulmones vacios)
text: Hold.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): exhalar, ciclo 1 (explica)
text: Now breathe out slowly through your mouth, as if through a straw.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): exhalar, ciclos 2 en adelante
text: And breathe out, slowly.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): final: ultima inhalacion profunda
text: One last time... breathe in deeply.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): final: exhalacion larga
text: Now a long, slow exhale... all the way out.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): final: sostener con los pulmones vacios
text: Hold, with your lungs empty.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): final: inhalar por la nariz
text: Breathe in through your nose.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): final: exhalar con un suspiro y una sonrisa
text: And let it go, with a sigh... and a smile.

uso: Breath, breathwork (21-10, arreglo 12): final: vuelta a la respiracion natural
text: Now let your breath return to its natural rhythm.

uso: Breath: final, antes de los resultados
text: Beautifully done. Let's see what your body shared with us.

uso: Draw: se fue el trazo de practica
text: Good. The space is yours now. Draw until the time or the ink runs out.

uso: Draw: final, antes de los resultados
text: Well done. This is what you created, and what your body was saying while you drew.

uso: menu: el HUD termino de instalarse, explica lo que se mide (pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: During this experience, we'll be measuring your neural activity, your heart activity, and a calm index.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 1 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Pick up the sensor in front of you with your dominant hand.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 2 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Rest the sensor on your belly, just below your ribs. Breathe normally.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 3 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Breathe in and out slowly. The circle follows your belly.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 4 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10) 20-10 tarde: sin START, solo la instruccion
text: You'll breathe in a steady cycle: inhale, hold, exhale. Follow the guide without forcing it.

uso: Draw, instrucciones pagina 1 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Pick up the brush with your dominant hand.

uso: Draw, instrucciones pagina 2 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Your palette is in your other hand. Point at a color to choose it, and hold the trigger to draw. Try a first stroke. The experience begins after your first stroke.

uso: menu, Heart elegido: bienvenida mientras se avanza (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia) (21-10: "Welcome to <experiencia>", pedido de Beltran)
text: Welcome to Recognizing. For the next three minutes, you'll listen to your heart. While you do, we'll gently listen to your body: your heart, and your mind.

uso: Heart, instrucciones pagina 1 (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Pick up the sensor in front of you with your dominant hand.

uso: Heart, instrucciones pagina 2 (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Place the sensor on your heart, on the left side of your chest. Then stay still for a moment.

uso: Heart, instrucciones pagina 3 (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia) (20-10 tarde: SIN USO, Heart quedo en dos paginas)
text: Each heartbeat becomes a pulse of light around you. Keep the sensor on your heart, and listen.

uso: Heart: primer pulso en el umbral (VO_17a del guion) (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Can you hear your heartbeat? Can you feel its rhythm?

uso: Heart: empieza la vuelta del mar (VO_17c del guion) (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Does gratitude flow through your heartbeat?

uso: Heart: final, antes de los resultados (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Beautifully done. Let's see what your heart shared with us.

uso: Heart: poema 1, a media etapa (21-10, pedido de Beltran: mas meditativo; del guion VO_15)
text: Let's redirect the focus to the heart... melting the thoughts of the mind. Here, there is nothing to do... only to listen.

uso: Heart: poema 2, antes del cierre (21-10, pedido de Beltran: mas meditativo)
text: Your heart has kept time for you, every moment of your life... quietly, without asking. Rest here, and thank it.

uso: menu: pista sin audio (subtitulo) para el boton START (20-10 tarde)
text: Point the button and press trigger

uso: menu: pista sin audio (subtitulo) para elegir experiencia (20-10 tarde)
text: Point the experience of your choice and press trigger
